device_enrollment.usb: root resolves exact selected USB sysfs/bus/interface to current /dev/bus/usb/<bus>/<device>; no generic allUSB allow
device_enrollment.pcie: root resolves exact selected PCI BDF/driver to corresponding /dev/apex_N, e.g. /dev/apex_0 only when actual mapping proves selection; no allapex wildcard
device_enrollment.caller_model_constraint: only fixed enrolled official sample or previously reviewed selected model, not arbitrary artifact selector

isolation: root constructs private device view exposing only standard safe process devices and exact selected TPU node; exact major/minor rw access, deny all other hardware, mknod/namespace/sysraw privilege; no broad PrivateDevices=no, wildcard USB/apex permissions or privileged worker. Filtered read-only selected sysfs metadata only as reviewed runtime requires; actual kernel proofs required.
reenumeration: detach/replug/reset/firmware reenumeration invalidates active binding/grants; root reattests same selected physical identity under fresh generation before exposure. Ambiguous identity/device replacement denies, never silently follows a reused path.
result_rule: root checks same selected launch/device binding and complete actual delegate evidence; enumeration/outputCPU alone not accepted

build_profiles.capability: root-enrolled installer build capability bound exact protected profile target; not caller-defined
build_profiles.constraint: no shell/script/compiler flag/source path/URL/output path from caller. Reviewed builder runs unprivileged dedicated build UID in custody private namespace, immutable fixed recipe over exact staged sources/toolchain. Upstream scripts with dynamic downloads not run generically.
build_profiles.outputs: root attests produced nativeARM64 executable/module/tree digests + source/compiler/recipe/build generation before runtime enrollment; exact failure/cancel logs redacted and prior valid outputs preserved
build_profiles.bounds: finite existing custody operation lease/resource limits, no unlimited compiler worker. Native build may be resumable distinct bounded stages each freshly authorized, never extend consumed grant.
build_profiles.pending: missing compiler/build deps, driver or native ABI qualification stays blocked with exact resume; no source metadata/build fixture treated as built binary
build_profiles.profile_resolution: root derives selected build_profile_id from fixedoperation recipe/enrollment/currentgeneration, no caller secondselector

evidence: actual selected device inference/kernel denial of siblingUSB/apex/unowned devices, hotplug/reuse/stale binding, caller device injection; actual source nativeARM64 build and wrong source/toolchain/recipe/path/network/timeout/recovery failures; fixture/native/hardware separate
source_note: official transport/driver/sample background reviewed; protected enrollment/node policy is installer design, not upstream guaranteed sandbox behavior
